gloss: having nothing to do; being at a loose end

definitions.gloss: having nothing to do; being bored; being idle; being at a loose end
definitions.explanation: A state of having nothing to occupy one's hands or time, resulting in restlessness or boredom. Composed of 手持ち (something in hand) + 無沙汰 (lack of activity).

examples.japanese: {手持|ても}ち{無沙汰|ぶさた}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{困|こま}った→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: I was at a loss with nothing to do.

examples.japanese: ⟦{待合室|まちあいしつ}→待合室：07373_machiaishitsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{手持|ても}ち{無沙汰|ぶさた}になった。
examples.english: I found myself with nothing to do in the waiting room.

examples.japanese: {手持|ても}ち{無沙汰|ぶさた}だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つぶした。
examples.english: I had nothing to do, so I watched videos on my phone to kill time.

notes:
USAGE:
{手持|ても}ち{無沙汰|ぶさた} describes the uncomfortable feeling of having nothing to do, especially in situations where one is waiting or has idle time. It can function as a na-adjective or noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手持|ても}ち{無沙汰|ぶさた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become idle/bored)
- {手持|ても}ち{無沙汰|ぶさた}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{困|こま}る→困る：00861_komaru⟧ (to be troubled by having nothing to do)
- {手持|ても}ち{無沙汰|ぶさた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{紛|まぎ}らわす→紛らわす：08206_magirawasu⟧ (to distract oneself from boredom)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{暇|ひま}→暇：00592_hima⟧ means free time or having nothing to do and is more casual. ⟦{退屈|たいくつ}→退屈：03389_taikutsu⟧ means boredom. {手持|ても}ち{無沙汰|ぶさた} specifically implies awkward idleness or restlessness from having nothing to occupy one's hands.
